registered_by: maintainer 2026-11-05 (independent review of f06ccd4), ruling 3 and section 2: '原则批准 six_category_common_support@v1，作为独立的新研究设计，不替代注册的 A1/A2/C1-6cat' ... '接受 six_category_common_support@v1 作为新的实验身份，三个 arm 为 A1-6cat-cs、A2-6cat-cs、C1-6cat-cs'
registered_identity_kept: configs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/six_category_design.json (A1-6cat / A2-6cat / C1-6cat) is unchanged and is not replaced; no result of this identity is a result of that one, and the two are never pooled
research_question: A teacher-mode distillation comparison matched on unique supervised-token budget and category composition: with one hybrid teacher (Qwen/Qwen3-4B), does its thinking mode (A1-6cat-cs) or its non-thinking mode (A2-6cat-cs) give the better student when both arms train on the same unique supervised tokens with the same category composition -- the composition both modes can supply (common support)? It is NOT a compute-matched comparison.
secondary_comparison: A1-6cat-cs vs C1-6cat-cs (hybrid thinking vs Thinking-2507, the same composition), each lineage end to end (P17.1); a secondary comparison only, with a stated confounder: C1's initialization search protocol differs from A1's
matched: each arm's total unique supervised tokens before packing (A arms 5,923,021; C1 its registered total)
the six supporting types at 1/6 each and the fluid category, cells and shares as registered
the tool type's internal category composition, identical in every arm (tool_calling below)
controls_unchanged: one teacher lineage per arm end to end (P17.1); each teacher's official template and preset
the pool tool_pool@v1 (content be4652d7...), its splits and frozen orders, tool_verification@v2 and every admission rule
selection: each arm's own admitted episodes, whole, in the pool's frozen order up to each category's target (tool_generation_plan.select); never by observed quality
Stage 3: random shuffle, sequential packing with truncation, standard causal attention (P19); counted before packing; the registered recipe, loss and schedule rule
validation, calibration and state-evaluation splits, their targets and verification as registered (the composition below applies to the TRAINING split only)

tool_calling.applies_to: the training split of every arm; calibration and state evaluation keep six_category_design.json's registered shares
tool_calling.quota_rule: the non-thinking training schema_arguments cell's projected LOWER bound (Wilson 90% x measured units per admitted episode over its whole supply) rounded DOWN to a hundred: 11,800 of the A arms' 493,417.83 tool-type tokens (share 0.023915); C1 the same share of its 492,587 (11,780.1); the six other categories keep their registered proportions and share the rest
tool_calling.quota_is_not_a_supply_guarantee: 11,800 is the low end of a statistical projection, not a guaranteed supply; when the verified supply is short, the fallback below -- registered before this generation -- applies

fallback.registered_before: the hybrid formal tool_generation and the Thinking-2507 top-up of 2026-11-05 (this file is bound by both sessions' plan)
fallback.reads_only: verified teacher data supply: admitted episodes and their unique supervised tokens under tool_verification@v2 (the dev box's tool_admission census). Never a student, search, training or evaluation result

rules.case: the non-thinking training schema_arguments cell's whole remaining compliant supply attempted (two candidates per task) and its admitted supervised tokens S below 11,800
rules.then: the common-support quota becomes Q = S rounded DOWN to a hundred; its share Q / 493,417.83 in every arm (C1: the same share of 492,587); the six other categories rescaled to the remainder in their registered proportions

rules.case: any other training cell of any arm short of its target after its whole compliant supply was attempted
rules.then: that category's share becomes the smallest over the three arms of (its verified admitted tokens / that arm's tool-type total), rounded down to a hundred A-arm tokens; the others rescaled in their registered proportions; the same composition in every arm

rules.case: a cell short with compliant supply remaining (its bound, its rounds or the budget boundary reached)
rules.then: NOT a fallback case: a SHORTFALL reported to the maintainer; a top-up continues from the frozen order (new tasks only) inside the cumulative budget, or the maintainer decides

fallback.never: duplication, relabelling, another split, a loss weight, regeneration of a sealed task, or any rule chosen after seeing a student result

whole_supply_cells.why: its target is the lower projection of its whole supply: its bound is its whole remaining compliant supply, so a shortfall there is a measured exhaustion, never a bound artefact

freeze.when: after the generation ends and before any search or training reads the data
frozen: each arm's final unique supervised tokens before packing, in total and per category
the realized proportions and each category's deviation from its target
the selected documents and episode identities (task id, candidate, shard sha256, content sha256)
the training input (the admitted documents in their frozen order) and its content identity
reported_per_arm: whole-episode overshoot per category (selected minus target)
freeze.kept_unselected: every admitted episode beyond a category's target stays in the records, unused: never regenerated, never borrowed across splits
freeze.matched_means: the category targets and the token budget, not identical tasks: each arm selects its own teacher's admitted episodes

recorded_beside_every_result: supervised-token exposure (unique supervised tokens x epochs, plus repeated fragments)
why_recorded: equal supervised tokens are not equal compute: the non-thinking arm's turns carry far more context per supervised token
no_new_student_controls: maintainer 2026-11-05: no additional Student training control is required in this round
interpretation_limits: a result of six_category_common_support@v1, never of the registered six-category identity, never pooled with it, and never described as the registered equal-proportion, equal-token A1/A2 comparison

argument construction (schema_arguments) carries about 2.4% of the tool type instead of 15% in every arm: the contrast says less about schema-heavy tool use, and nothing about the registered composition

the composition is supply-conditioned: it was chosen because the non-thinking teacher's verified output on this pool is short -- a property of the data, fixed before generation, not of any training or evaluation outcome
tool-calling and every other capability reported separately (P10.2, P10.3); eval-set-1 unchanged
two seeds per arm: differences below the seed-to-seed variance are not findings
authorizes: nothing by itself: generation runs under the grant's tool_generation and tool_generation_t2507 scopes; search, training and evaluation need their own decisions
